title: Desktop / Following
slide_intent: Give familiar channels a clear place in the interface so returning viewers can reconnect quickly.
strategic_value: Grouping followed streams can let Twitch’s content relationships lead while its identity stays present in the surrounding UI.
demonstration: A dark Following screen groups live-channel thumbnails and additional rows of content inside the desktop navigation.
practical_value: Compare how channel thumbnails, metadata and grouping support return visits.

content_islands.name: Following hierarchy
content_islands.spec: Place the Following title and tabs above grouped channel content.

content_islands.name: Channel rows
content_islands.spec: Arrange live thumbnails with names and supporting metadata beneath.

content_islands.name: Presentation background
content_islands.spec: Keep the blue-to-purple ground outside the dark product screenshot.

reference_purposes.Application: The desktop Following example organizes channel content within a branded interface.
